title: Block of a sign vector
statement: Let $s$ and $w$ be natural numbers, let $x\in\{-1,1\}^{sw}$, and let $i\in\{0,\ldots,s-1\}$. The $i$th block of $x$ is the sign vector of length $w$ whose coordinate $j$ is the coordinate of $x$ indexed by the pair $(i,j)$ under the standard identification of the $sw$ coordinates with pairs.
